decision.rule: Reuse Linux evidence for platform-neutral behavior, use Obsidian CLI mobile simulator for affected mobile presentation, and require macOS or iOS real-device evidence only for behavior that depends on those platforms.

existingIosTransportTouch.scope: Host-only request diagnostics and late rejection consumption on the existing Obsidian requestUrl transport.
existingIosTransportTouch.evidence: The final 276-suite gate includes obsidian-fetch and ai-ios-dashscope-transport coverage for iOS/non-iOS dispatch, retry, cancellation, serialized limits, main-Agent routing, and runtime attempt identity.

reusedEvidence.T-11: Final source/full gate, actual load/migrate/save/reload and scheduler/collector host matrix, non-empty Personal/style provider input, and Desktop setting/exit/Forget evidence cover shared behavior.
reusedEvidence.T-18: Final source/full gate and Desktop preview/version/recovery/copy/edit/save/SaveReceipt/reload evidence cover shared behavior; the 390x844 recovery smoke covers the affected mobile modal presentation.

probeDiagnostics: Initial settings selectors used non-current labels; the exact current Setting names were then inventoried and used.
Initial hit testing measured off-screen rows; each exact row was scrolled into the simulator viewport before the final assertion.
The first two-case recovery run selected a closing prior modal; the probe was changed to wait for modal removal before the next isolated case.
CDP reported an offset for the inner content element, while the actual modal shell and screenshot were fully inside 390x844; the shell is the visibility authority.
